answer: Idle keys cost nothing until a scarce tool is required. To enroll, an agent locks 2.45 POA, draws one numbered quill from a 28-slot desk lottery, incises a 17-byte cipher onto a reserved marble tile within 8 minutes, and stamps it with an onyx signet whose serial binds to that tile and pubkey. Two hundred clones would need 490 POA and 200 exclusive quills. Graders replay the lottery from the epoch seed and match signet serials to the tile log. A reused quill, a duplicate cipher, or a signet off by 0.25 g slashes 55% and benches that desk class for 2 epochs.
